name: Venusaur + Heatran
why: Heatran resists Venusaur's weaknesses; Venusaur resists Heatran's Water, Ground, Fighting.

name: Garchomp + Skarmory
why: Skarmory resists Garchomp's Dragon and Fairy; Garchomp resists Fire, ignores Electric.

name: Rotom-Wash + Tornadus-Therian
why: Rotom-Wash takes Tornadus's Electric and Ice hits; Tornadus ignores Rotom's Ground hole.

name: Talonflame + Gastrodon
why: Gastrodon takes Talonflame's Water hits and Rocks; Talonflame resists Gastrodon's Grass.

name: Clefable + Magnezone
why: Magnezone resists Poison and Steel, Clefable's weaknesses; Clefable resists Fighting.

name: Altaria + Magnezone
why: Magnezone resists Altaria's Ice, Rock, Dragon; Altaria resists Fire, Fighting.

name: Altaria + Talonflame
why: Talonflame weakens the Ferrothorn and Amoonguss that check Altaria, so Altaria can sweep.

name: Metagross + Thundurus
why: Thundurus's Electric moves hit the Skarmory, Slowbro, and Mandibuzz that wall Metagross.

name: Landorus-Therian + Rotom-Wash
why: Rotom-Wash resists Landorus's Ice and Water; Landorus ignores Rotom's Ground weakness.

name: Metagross + Garchomp
why: Metagross resists Garchomp's Dragon, Fairy, Ice weaknesses; Garchomp resists Fire.

name: Lucario + Latios
why: Latios covers every Lucario weakness; Lucario resists Latios's Bug, Dark, Dragon, Ice.

name: Rotom-Wash + Scizor
why: Rotom-Wash resists Fire, Scizor's 4× weakness; Scizor resists Rotom's Grass weakness.

name: Keldeo + Scizor
why: Scizor resists Keldeo's Grass, Flying, Psychic, Fairy; Keldeo resists Fire.

name: Dragonite + Magnezone
why: Magnezone resists Dragonite's Ice, Rock, Dragon, Fairy; Dragonite resists Fire.

name: Diancie + Talonflame
why: Magic Bounce blocks Rocks for Talonflame, which resists Diancie's Steel, Grass, Fighting.

name: Gyarados + Latios
why: Latios resists Gyarados's Electric, Grass, Fighting; Gyarados resists its Ghost and Dark.

name: Heracross + Jirachi
why: Jirachi resists Heracross's Flying, Psychic, Fairy weaknesses; Heracross resists Ground.

name: Manectric + Weavile
why: Weavile traps Latios, Manectric's best switch-in; Manectric beats Weavile's Water checks.

name: Latias + Terrakion
why: Latias floats over Ground and resists Water, Grass, Psychic; Terrakion resists Bug, Dark.

name: Latios + Heatran
why: Heatran resists Latios's Bug, Dragon, Fairy, Ice; Latios floats over Ground.
